annotations.title: Get a payment link for Plus

description: Use this when the person wants the paid Plus service for their palimpalem website, which keeps it online without limits after the free trial. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Returns a payment link on palimpalem.com with the price; the person pays there. This tool charges nothing.

billing.description: Pay per year or per month. The person can still switch on the payment page.

web.description: Optional when the account has one website.
